Banner.Description: I am a DevOps / Cloud / Platform Engineer with six+ years of experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure and deployment pipelines for large-scale enterprise systems. My expertise spans Kubernetes (GKE), CI/CD automation, application modernization, observability, and security. I specialize in transforming complex legacy environments into automated, reliable, and scalable platforms.
AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I am a DevOps / Cloud / Platform Engineer with six+ years of experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure and deployment pipelines for large-scale enterprise systems.
My work spans cloud and Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, application modernization, observability, and security and governance.
My core strength is turning complex, legacy environments into automated, observable, and reliable systems without disrupting business operations.
I continuously focus on improving systems, automating workflows, and collaborating with cross-functional teams including developers, SREs, infrastructure, and security teams.
Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: Collaboration & Agile Delivery
Description: Cross-Functional Leadership: Acted as a technical 'translator' between Developers, SREs, and Security teams to align platform constraints with business requirements.
Agile Ownership: Led Epic-level initiatives, including the migration to ephemeral build agents and the containerization of legacy IBM Sterling systems.
Scrum & Kanban: Actively participated in sprint planning and retrospectives to identify technical risks, dependencies, and workflow improvements.
Platform Advocacy: Documented reference architectures and 'how-to' patterns to enable self-service DevOps and scale best practices across the engineering org.
Incident Coordination: Partnered with infrastructure and application teams during high-pressure incidents to ensure rapid recovery and clear communication.

Experience.Jobs.Title: CI/CD, Build Engineering & Release Automation
Description: End‑to‑End Pipelines: Designed Bamboo CI and ArgoCD GitOps pipelines for automated build, test (unit/integration/linting), and Helm chart packaging.
GitOps Delivery: Managed environment states (Dev/Test/Prod) via Git repositories with ArgoCD for automated sync, drift detection, and self‑healing.
Ephemeral Agents: Migrated from static build servers to ephemeral Kubernetes-based agents, using custom-built versioned images for isolated and scalable builds.
Build Performance: Implemented shared Persistent Volume Claims (PVC) mounted to agent pods to cache dependencies and Docker layers, significantly reducing build times.
Automation & Scale: Leveraged progressive rollouts and automated rollbacks tied to Git changes, delivering a repeatable and auditable release process.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Cloud & Kubernetes Platform Engineering
Description: Kubernetes Architecture: Translating requirements into GKE primitives: Deployments, StatefulSets, Jobs, Services, Ingress, and ConfigMaps.
Containerization: Building Docker images for microservices and monolithic IBM Sterling stacks using multi-stage builds and externalized configuration.
External Integration: Configuring secure connectivity to Oracle, IBM MQ, and Control-M using TLS, Keystores, and Kubernetes Secrets.
Resilience: Implementing Liveness/Readiness/Startup probes and Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) with tuned CPU/Memory requests.
Impact: Transitioned from static server deployments to declarative K8s automation, significantly improving recovery speed and application uptime.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Observability, Performance & Reliability (SRE)
Description: Infrastructure Telemetry: Instrumented Bamboo and GKE clusters to emit metrics on job queue lengths, build durations, and agent resource utilization.
Custom Dashboards: Developed real-time visualizations for build system health and capacity trends, reducing the mean time to detect (MTTD) infrastructure bottlenecks.
Workload Monitoring: Configured log shipping and Prometheus metrics scraping for microservices to track SLIs, including error rates, latency, and request counts.
Incident Management: Led root cause analysis (RCA) for production pod crashes and performance degradation, implementing 'golden signals' to reduce alert noise.
Reliability Engineering: Strengthened system resilience by updating deployment templates and 'golden' patterns based on post-incident findings.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Security, IAM & Governance
Description: Cloud IAM & Least Privilege: Managed GKE Workload Identity and service accounts for CI/CD pipelines and AI/ML services using strict least-privilege policies.
Governance & Access Control: Administered repository permissions and branch protection rules in Bitbucket/GitHub to ensure auditable access and secure collaboration.
Secrets Management: Enforced secure handling of credentials using Secret Managers and Vault integrations, eliminating hardcoded secrets in repositories and pipelines.
Vulnerability Remediation: Conducted routine image hardening by patching OS packages and application libraries, ensuring zero functional regressions during rollouts.
Compliance & Hardening: Integrated security scanners into build processes to maintain enterprise compliance and protect containerized workloads from vulnerabilities.

FeatureProjects.Title: My projects
FeatureProjects.Label: Featured Project

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Daily Trending Repo Mirror Catalog
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A public, always-current catalog mirroring 10-20 trending DevOps and AI repositories every day -- each imported as a full code copy, credited to its upstream source, with a one-line note on what it is used for. An automated workflow keeps every mirror synced with upstream daily. My way of staying hands-on with what is actually moving in the ecosystem.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Enterprise GitOps Migration at Scale
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Led the migration of 150+ microservices from hand-written Kubernetes manifests to standardized Helm charts with ArgoCD-driven GitOps deployments. A git push now triggers automated, audited rollouts with quality gates -- replacing hours of error-prone manual kubectl deploys per release and eliminating a whole class of deployment incidents.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Observability & SRE Practice
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Designed the observability stack -- Grafana, Prometheus and Loki with Filebeat and ELK -- used for monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting and autoscaling of production services. Golden signals, actionable alert routing and runbooks, so any on-call engineer can respond to an incident without paging the one expert.
